properties.description: New construction of a wireless telecommunication tower. Work to include Proposed 105 monopole and antennas ground equipment on new 11x4 concrete slab and new chain-link fence.  VLRA batteries in cabinets will be submitted for a HAZMAT permit once BP application is approved.  No backup generator is proposed
